notes:
Vekil Pro is a practice-management and legal-research app for lawyers in Turkey. The interface is Turkish.

1. PURPOSE AND TARGET AUDIENCE
The app is for licensed attorneys and law offices in Turkey. It replaces paper and spreadsheet workflows: case files, clients, hearing calendar, statutory deadlines, fee and expense tracking, petition drafting, and full-text search of published Turkish court decisions. Value: a lawyer can find binding precedent and track every deadline from a phone instead of a desktop system.

2. HOW TO ACCESS THE MAIN FEATURES
Sign-up is free and takes seconds: email + password, no invitation, no waiting list, no manual approval. The reviewer can create an account directly in the app. A demo account is therefore not required, but if one is preferred we will provide credentials on request.
After sign-up, everything below is reachable from the bottom tab bar:
- Dashboard: upcoming hearings and deadlines
- Cases: create a case, attach a client, add hearings and documents
- Search: type any legal term in Turkish (for example 'kidem tazminati') to search published court decisions
- Calculators: severance, notice, interest
- Settings > KVKK: privacy notice and consent toggle; Settings > Account: deletion

3. WHAT IS FREE AND WHAT IS PAID
Free: case files, clients, hearings, deadlines, calendar, reminders, calculators, petition templates, and unlimited full-text search of Turkish court decisions.
Paid: unlimited records plus the finance module (Vekil Pro, 399 TRY/month) and the AI assistant (Vekil Pro AI, 2999 TRY/month). Both are auto-renewing subscriptions in one group and can be tested with a StoreKit sandbox account. A lock icon means a paywall, not a defect.

4. ACCOUNT DELETION
Settings > Account > Delete account. Deletion is immediate and removes the user's records.

5. USER-GENERATED CONTENT
The mobile app has no public user-generated content, no social feed, no comments and no messaging between users. Everything a user creates is private to that user's account. (A colleague-to-colleague job board exists only on the web version and is not part of this iOS build.)

6. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase (PostgreSQL database, authentication, storage) - servers in Ireland (EU)
- Anthropic (large language model) - powers the optional AI assistant only
- RevenueCat (subscription receipt validation)
- Apple Push Notification service (hearing and deadline reminders)
- Court decision data: public decisions published by the Turkish judiciary (Yargitay, Danistay, UYAP Emsal). No private or paid data provider is used.
There is no advertising SDK, no analytics SDK and no tracking.

7. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. The app is offered in Turkey only and behaves identically for every user. Content is Turkish law; there is no region-gated feature.

8. CONTENT AND AGE RATING
The case-law texts are public court decisions. Criminal decisions describe violent and sexual offences in factual legal language, which is why the age rating was declared 12+ rather than 4+.

9. PRIVACY
No advertising, no tracking, no IDFA. Text a user explicitly sends to the AI assistant is transmitted to a third-party model provider; that transfer requires the user's separate, revocable consent. Without consent the AI features stay off and every other feature keeps working.
